mapper.select: select i.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.use_yn from mst_item i where i.item_cd = #{itemCd}

select s.bom_id as src_bom_id, d.bom_id as draft_bom_id, d.rev as draft_rev, and t.bom_id = d.bom_id and e.eco_id <> #{ecoId} limit 1) as open_eco_no, exists (select 1 from plm_eco_target t where t.bom_id = d.bom_id and t.eco_id = #{ecoId}) as in_this from mst_bom s join mst_bom d on d.item_id = s.item_id and d.alt_no = s.alt_no and d.status = 'DRAFT' where s.bom_id in #{id}
select t.item_id from plm_eco_target t where t.eco_id = #{ecoId} and t.target_type = 'ITEM'
select exists (select 1 from sys_plant p where p.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and p.use_yn = 'Y')
select c.cust_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm from mst_cust c where c.cust_cd = #{custCd} and c.use_yn = 'Y' and c.cust_type in ('SALES', 'BOTH')
select c.cust_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm from mst_cust c where c.use_yn = 'Y' and c.cust_type in ('SALES', 'BOTH') order by c.cust_cd limit 500
select hb_code_usable(hb_current_comp(), 'PLM_CHANGE_REASON', #{code})
select q.equip_id from mst_equip q where q.equip_cd = #{equipCd} and q.use_yn = 'Y'
select p.proc_id from mst_proc p where p.proc_cd = #{procCd} and p.use_yn = 'Y'

select d.doc_id, d.doc_type, r.doc_rev_id, r.rev, r.status, (select e.eco_no from plm_eco_target t join plm_eco e on e.eco_id = t.eco_id where e.status in ('DRAFT', 'PENDING', 'APPROVED') and t.doc_rev_id = r.doc_rev_id and e.eco_id <> #{ecoId} limit 1) as open_eco_no from mst_doc d left join mst_doc_rev r on r.doc_id = d.doc_id and r.status in ('DRAFT', 'IN_APPROVAL') where d.doc_no = #{docNo} and d.use_yn = 'Y' limit 1
mapper.update: update sys_file set locked_yn = 'Y', row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where target_type = 'plm-eco' and target_id = #{targetId} and use_yn = 'Y' and locked_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: select exists (select 1 from plm_eco_target t join plm_eco e on e.eco_id = t.eco_id where t.doc_rev_id = #{docRevId} and e.status in ('PENDING', 'APPROVED'))
mapper.sql: (select e.eco_no from plm_eco_target t join plm_eco e on e.eco_id = t.eco_id where e.status in ('DRAFT', 'PENDING', 'APPROVED')
mapper.select: select * from ( select 'BOM' as target_type, b.bom_id as ref_id, b.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, b.rev, b.alt_no, null::varchar as plant_cd, b.valid_from, b.row_ver, and t.bom_id = b.bom_id limit 1) as open_eco_no from mst_bom b join mst_item i on i.item_id = b.item_id where b.status = 'DRAFT' and b.item_id = #{itemId} union all select 'ROUTING', r.routing_id, r.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, r.rev, r.alt_no, r.plant_cd, r.valid_from, r.row_ver, and t.routing_id = r.routing_id limit 1) from mst_routing r join mst_item i on i.item_id = r.item_id where r.status = 'DRAFT' and r.item_id = #{itemId} ) c order by c.item_cd, c.target_type, c.plant_cd nulls first, c.alt_no limit #{limit}

select b.bom_id as ref_id, b.item_id, b.status, b.row_ver, b.rev, trim_scale(b.base_qty)::text as base_qty, b.remark, and t.bom_id = b.bom_id and e.eco_id <> #{ecoId} limit 1) as open_eco_no from mst_bom b where b.bom_id = #{bomId}

select r.routing_id as ref_id, r.item_id, r.status, r.row_ver, r.rev, null as base_qty, r.remark, and t.routing_id = r.routing_id and e.eco_id <> #{ecoId} limit 1) as open_eco_no from mst_routing r where r.routing_id = #{routingId}
mapper.sql: from plm_ecr r join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.requester_id left join mst_item i on i.item_id = r.item_id left join plm_eco e on e.eco_id = r.eco_id

where.if: and (upper(r.ecr_no) like #{keyword} escape '\' or upper(r.title) like #{keyword} escape '\')

update plm_ecr set status = #{status}, eco_id = #{ecoId}, decision_comment = #{comment}, decided_at = now(), decided_by = #{by}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where ecr_id = #{ecrId} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and status = 'OPEN'

from plm_eco e join sys_user o on o.user_id = e.owner_id left join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = e.cust_id left join apr_request a on a.apr_id = e.apr_id left join mst_item si on si.item_id = e.stock_item_id

and exists (select 1 from plm_eco_target t where t.eco_id = e.eco_id and t.item_id = #{itemId})

select e.eco_id, e.eco_no, e.title, e.reason_cd, e.effective_date, e.owner_id, e.cust_approval_req_yn, e.cust_id, e.cust_approval_status, e.status, e.apr_id, e.change_kind, e.mark_lots, e.mark_until, e.apply_cond, e.stock_item_id, e.stock_plant_cd, e.row_ver from plm_eco e where e.eco_id = #{ecoId} for update

insert into plm_eco (comp_cd, eco_no, title, reason_cd, description, effective_date, owner_id, cust_approval_req_yn, cust_id, cust_approval_status, change_kind, mark_lots, mark_until, apply_cond, stock_item_id, stock_plant_cd, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{no}, #{v.title}, #{v.reasonCd}, #{v.description}, #{v.effectiveDate}, #{v.ownerId}, #{v.custApprovalReqYn}, #{v.custId}, #{v.custApprovalStatus}, #{v.changeKind}, #{v.markLots,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{v.markUntil,jdbcType=DATE}, #{v.applyCond}, #{v.stockItemId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{v.stockPlantCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{by}, #{by}) returning eco_id
mapper.update: update plm_eco set title = #{v.title}, reason_cd = #{v.reasonCd}, description = #{v.description}, effective_date = #{v.effectiveDate}, owner_id = #{v.ownerId}, cust_approval_req_yn = #{v.custApprovalReqYn}, cust_id = #{v.custId}, change_kind = #{v.changeKind}, mark_lots = #{v.markLots,jdbcType=INTEGER}, mark_until = #{v.markUntil,jdbcType=DATE}, apply_cond = #{v.applyCond}, stock_item_id = #{v.stockItemId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, stock_plant_cd = #{v.stockPlantCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, cust_approval_status = case when #{v.custApprovalReqYn} = 'N' then 'NA' when cust_approval_status = 'NA' then 'PENDING' else cust_approval_status end, cust_approval_ref = case when #{v.custApprovalReqYn} = 'N' then null else cust_approval_ref end, cust_approved_on = case when #{v.custApprovalReqYn} = 'N' then null else cust_approved_on end, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where eco_id = #{ecoId} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and status = 'DRAFT'
update plm_eco set row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where eco_id = #{ecoId} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and status = 'DRAFT'
update plm_eco set status = 'PENDING', submitted_at = now(), row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where eco_id = #{ecoId} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and status = 'DRAFT'
update plm_eco set apr_id = #{aprId} where eco_id = #{ecoId} and status = 'PENDING'

update plm_eco set status = #{status}, approved_at = case when #{status} = 'APPROVED' then now() else approved_at end, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where eco_id = #{ecoId} and status = 'PENDING'
update plm_eco_target set base_row_ver = null, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where eco_id = #{ecoId} and base_row_ver is not null

update plm_eco set cust_approval_status = #{status}, cust_approval_ref = #{ref}, cust_approved_on = #{approvedOn}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where eco_id = #{ecoId} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and cust_approval_req_yn = 'Y' and status in ('DRAFT', 'PENDING', 'APPROVED')
mapper.select: select t.target_id, t.seq, t.target_type, t.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, t.bom_id, t.routing_id, t.equip_id, q.equip_cd, q.equip_nm, t.proc_id, p.proc_cd, p.proc_nm, t.doc_rev_id, dd.doc_no, dd.doc_nm, (t.doc_rev_id is not null and t.item_id is not null and exists (select 1 from mst_doc_target dt where dt.doc_id = dd.doc_id and dt.target_type in ('ITEM', 'ITEM_CLASS')) and not exists (select 1 from mst_doc_target dt where dt.doc_id = dd.doc_id and ((dt.target_type = 'ITEM' and dt.item_id = t.item_id) or (dt.target_type = 'ITEM_CLASS' and dt.item_class_id = i.item_class_id)))) as doc_target_warn, coalesce(b.rev, r.rev, dr.rev) as rev, r.plant_cd, coalesce(b.status, r.status, dr.status) as ref_status, coalesce(b.row_ver, r.row_ver, dr.row_ver) as ref_row_ver, coalesce(b.valid_from, r.valid_from) as ref_valid_from, coalesce(b.change_no, r.change_no) as ref_change_no, t.change_desc, t.base_row_ver, t.row_ver from plm_eco_target t left join mst_item i on i.item_id = t.item_id left join mst_bom b on b.bom_id = t.bom_id left join mst_routing r on r.routing_id = t.routing_id left join mst_equip q on q.equip_id = t.equip_id left join mst_proc p on p.proc_id = t.proc_id left join mst_doc_rev dr on dr.doc_rev_id = t.doc_rev_id left join mst_doc dd on dd.doc_id = dr.doc_id where t.eco_id = #{ecoId} order by t.seq
mapper.insert: insert into plm_eco_target (comp_cd, eco_id, seq, target_type, item_id, bom_id, routing_id, equip_id, proc_id, doc_rev_id, change_desc, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{ecoId}, #{seq}, #{type}, #{itemId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{bomId}, #{routingId}, #{equipId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{procId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{docRevId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{changeDesc}, #{by}, #{by})
mapper.select: select m.seq_no, m.mark_reason, m.lot_id, l.lot_no, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, w.wo_no, q.equip_cd, m.occurred_at, m.recorded_at from plm_eco_lot m join lot_master l on l.lot_id = m.lot_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id left join prd_wo w on w.wo_id = m.wo_id left join mst_equip q on q.equip_id = m.equip_id where m.eco_id = #{ecoId} order by m.seq_no limit #{limit}

select l.seq, l.approver_id, u.user_nm as approver_nm, l.line_type, l.status, l.acted_at, l.comment from apr_line l join sys_user u on u.user_id = l.approver_id where l.apr_id = #{aprId} order by l.seq
select status from apr_request where apr_id = #{aprId}
select status from plm_eco where eco_id = #{ecoId}
